Escape to Your Private Oasis
Adults-Only Boutique Escape in Costa Rica
A Hidden Jungle Sanctuary Overlooking the Pacific
Nestled deep in the lush rainforest of Uvita, Oxygen Jungle Villas offers an intimate adults-only retreat with breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean.
Wake to the soothing sounds of nature, unwind in your private jungle haven, and breathe in the fresh ocean air from the pristine beaches just a 10-minute drive away. As the day fades, watch the sky ignite in color from our palm-lined infinity pool.
From unforgettable adventures to moments of pure relaxation, Oxygen Jungle Villas invites you to experience your own private oasis in Costa Rica.
Our stay at Oxygen Jungle Villas was nothing short of magical.

Villas - Oxygen Villas
Your Private
Paradise
Enjoy Your Stay
More than a place to stay, Oxygen Jungle Villas is an experience designed for privacy, tranquility, and connection with nature.
Our adults-only boutique retreat features just twelve villas — eight with sweeping ocean views and four immersed in the jungle. Each space is thoughtfully designed with floor-to-ceiling glass walls and a private terrace, creating a seamless connection between you and the surrounding rainforest.
Wake to the sounds of nature, spot toucans and hummingbirds just beyond your villa, and unwind in a space where contemporary design enhances — never competes with — the beauty outside.
Every villa is equipped with climate control, a king-sized four-poster bed, minibar, and refined comforts to ensure your stay feels as effortless as it is unforgettable.
Explore All Accommodations
The villas are perfectly designed to feel like you are part of the nature around you, while still offering amenities like AC and room service if you would like it. Also, the beds are extremely comfortable.

Amenities & Services
Airport Pick-up
Arrive with ease. Private airport transfers can be arranged to ensure a smooth, comfortable journey from arrival to your villa.
Housekeeper
Your villa, always at its best. Daily housekeeping and evening turndown service ensure a space that feels consistently fresh, inviting, and effortless.
Gourmet Breakfast
Start your day with a thoughtfully prepared gourmet breakfast, included with your stay and inspired by the flavors of Costa Rica.
Private Car Park
Enjoy the convenience of complimentary private parking, offering ease and security throughout your stay.
Infinity Pool
Unwind at our infinity pool, where rainforest views meet the Pacific horizon — the perfect setting to relax, refresh, and take it all in.
River Spa Access
Experience our signature River Spa, where treatments are inspired by Costa Rican wellness traditions and surrounded by the sounds of the jungle.
Private Jungle Trails
Step into nature along private jungle trails, where lush rainforest and native wildlife create a truly immersive experience.
In-Villa Spa Treatments
Enjoy personalized spa treatments in the privacy of your villa, delivered by experienced therapists for a deeply relaxing experience.
Room Service
Indulge in 8am - 9pm room service, with a curated selection of meals and beverages delivered directly to your villa.
Conciergerie Service
Our concierge team is here to curate your stay — from dining reservations to unforgettable local experiences.
Dedicated Team
A team devoted to your experience, ensuring every detail of your stay feels seamless, personalized, and truly exceptional.
Frequently Asked Questions
Find answers to the most common questions about your stay at Oxygen Jungle Villas, including our villas, amenities, spa experiences, and resort services.
Call Us for More Information
+50683224773
Transfer Service and Airport Transportation
For our guests, arriving at the resort can be completely effortless. We are happy to arrange private airport transfers upon request from major airports in Costa Rica. Our team can coordinate comfortable transportation directly to the resort, ensuring a smooth and relaxing start to your stay. Please contact our concierge in advance to organize your transfer.
Transport and Parking
Guests arriving by car will find convenient and complimentary parking available at the resort. Our team will assist you upon arrival and ensure a seamless check-in experience so you can begin enjoying the tranquility of the jungle and ocean views right away.
Concierge Service
Our concierge team is available to assist you throughout your stay. Whether you need help booking excursions, arranging transportation, planning romantic experiences, or discovering the best activities in the surrounding area, our staff is here to make your stay as memorable and effortless as possible.
Spa and Wellness Experiences
Guests can enjoy relaxing wellness experiences at our River Spa or in the privacy of select villas. Our treatments are inspired by traditional Costa Rican remedies and natural ingredients, offering a rejuvenating experience for the body and mind in a tranquil jungle setting.
Resort Amenities
Each stay includes access to a variety of exclusive amenities designed for comfort and relaxation. Guests can enjoy a gourmet breakfast, infinity pool, yoga deck, hiking trails, private waterfalls, daily housekeeping service, and access to the River Lounge and spa facilities.

description.@value: Oxygen Jungle Villas is an adults-only luxury villa retreat above Uvita on Costa Rica's South Pacific coast, overlooking Marino Ballena National Park. Its twelve private villas — eight with ocean views and four immersed in the jungle, several with in-villa spa treatments — surround a pool, spa, and restaurant, complemented by airport transfers, room service, and guided whale-watching tours in the adjacent Marino Ballena National Park, with a maximum of 24 guests at any time. It is a TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice "Best of the Best" winner and rated the #1 best value among stays in Uvita.

Oxygen Jungle Villas es un refugio de villas de lujo solo para adultos sobre Uvita, en la costa del Pacífico Sur de Costa Rica, con vista al Parque Nacional Marino Ballena. Sus doce villas privadas —ocho con vista al mar y cuatro inmersas en la selva, varias con tratamientos de spa dentro de la villa— rodean una piscina, un spa y un restaurante, y se complementan con traslados al aeropuerto, servicio a la habitación y tours guiados de avistamiento de ballenas en el vecino Parque Nacional Marino Ballena, con un máximo de 24 huéspedes a la vez. Es ganador del premio TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice Best of the Best y está calificado como la mejor relación calidad-precio entre las estadías en Uvita.
